title: Bids paused: fills are being picked off
body: 3 of the last 6 fills were picked off (the fair had already moved under the price when the next scan priced them): average EV at the fill +0.0% against +2.7% when posted. Bids are stopped: look at the fills (Diagnostics › Bids), then Resume bids on the Bids tab. The engine starts again in 60 minutes from the fills after this one.
